phase: Phase 1 ordinary fenced code and native Tree-sitter highlighting

h1.attribution: Same 124-file app bundle. No new dependency or shipped test, benchmark, or fixture artifact.

decisionAndErrorBranches: closed language and two accepted aliases select one of five native grammars
unknown, rich, and ordinary non-approved fences use pre-existing escaped fallback
source larger than 256 KiB and document block 101+ use escaped fallback
cancellation before or after C work uses escaped fallback
C allocation, parser, language, query, cursor, capture, token-category, range, UTF-8-boundary, and overlap anomalies fail closed
only closed palette spans are emitted; source slices are HTML escaped
query compilation and ignored-capture filtering finish before pthread_once publication
Tree-sitter parser, tree, cursor, and result state is created and freed in the invoking C call
the direct UTF-8 builder rejects invalid conversion or capacity overflow and uses escaped fallback
render entry points require an explicit typed policy; an absent reader context fails closed to disabled highlighting
only language-, size-, cancellation-, and basic-feasibility-eligible fences claim a shared document budget slot
the byte assembler accepts only a private validated token stream whose ranges were checked against the active UTF-8 buffer
reader policy shares one synchronized highlighted-fence budget across root conversion and transclusions
chat policy disables native token spans and retains escaped ordinary fenced code
the CodeHighlightBenchmark release probe accepts only its closed nested-Scala mode and ignored benchmark-directory JSON output path, then records a process-wide RSS limitation
directCoverageLimits: The C allocation-failure branch is not deterministically injectable through the production ABI.
Sanitizer support depends on the local Swift/Clang linker toolchain; command output is retained separately from functional test results.
historicalEvidenceLimitations: release-byte-buffer-aggregate-record.json captured head equal to base from an out-of-tree probe harness; it is retained as a historical performance record, not exact-head identity evidence.

F2, G1, H1, and sanitizer records retain their original immutable heads. The final H1 decision is a separate exact-head exception record. The M-2 corrective cycle writes separate ignored exact-head records and does not rewrite historical evidence.

baselineGateLimitations.result: Both exits are 1 with the same two provider-wrapper assertions.
baselineGateLimitations.cause: ChatWebView.toolDetailPayload intentionally removes a complete provider-added Markdown fence before escaping the tool detail. The Phase 1 .chat Markdown policy does not change this path.
baselineGateLimitations.disposition: Retain as a baseline limitation. Do not claim that the app-enabled full suite passed or modify ChatWebView.toolDetailPayload or LauncherChatAgentRuntimeTests in Phase 1.
